description: EODHD symbols for identifiers of the 110-name 2016 PIT universe that the rule in mci_gru/data/eodhd_prices.py default_symbol cannot map: renamed, reused, predecessor and delisted tickers (#281). Each segment lists candidate symbols tried in order, then EODHD's US listings whose company name contains name_hint. When the pull is given the preserved LSEG panel, a candidate is accepted only if its returns agree with that panel over the span the universe needs, so a wrong guess here stops the pull rather than entering the panel. Dates are inclusive and follow the listing changes.

DD.N^I17.note: E. I. du Pont de Nemours, traded as DD until the Dow merger closed on 2017-08-31. The DD ticker was later reused by DowDuPont, now DuPont de Nemours.

DOW.N^I17.note: The Dow Chemical Company, traded as DOW until the DuPont merger closed on 2017-08-31. The DOW ticker was reused by Dow Inc. in 2019.

DD.N.note: DowDuPont from 2017-09-01, renamed DuPont de Nemours in 2019. Older DD rows are the previous company (DD.N^I17).

DOW.N.note: Dow Inc., spun off from DowDuPont; the LSEG panel starts 2019-03-20.

LIN.OQ.note: Linde plc from 2018-10-31. LSEG carries Praxair (PX) before it; Praxair holders received one LIN share each. The PX ticker now belongs to P10 Inc.

BKR.OQ.note: Baker Hughes, a GE company (BHGE) from 2017-07-05, renamed BKR in 2019. LSEG carries Baker Hughes Inc (BHI) before it.

PSKY.OQ.note: Paramount Skydance from 2025-08-07. Before it LSEG carries Paramount Global (PARA), formerly ViacomCBS (VIAC) and CBS Corp (CBS); the universe needs only the 2015-2017 CBS stretch.

RTX.N.note: United Technologies (UTX) until 2020-04-02; renamed Raytheon Technologies on the Raytheon merger, later RTX Corp.

CB.N.note: ACE Limited (ACE) until it acquired Chubb on 2016-01-14 and took the CB ticker.

BALL.N.note: Ball Corporation traded as BLL until its 2022 ticker change.

ATVI.OQ^J23.note: Delisted 2023-10-13 on its acquisition by Microsoft.

HES.N^G25.note: Delisted 2025-07-18 on its acquisition by Chevron.

PXD.N^E24.note: Delisted 2024-05-03 on its acquisition by Exxon Mobil.
